name: CSN 371 自动刹车警告 丢失几页飞行手册

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 371, a flight from Wuhan to Moscow, you are at bay 224, you have got information C, request ATC clearance to Moscow from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 371，从武汉飞往莫斯科，在 224 号机位，已收到通播 C，向武汉放行请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 371, bay 224, information C, request ATC clearance to Moscow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 371，224 号机位，通播 C，请求飞往莫斯科的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF-01 departure, cruising level 8900 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，许可飞往莫斯科，按飞行计划航路，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 8900 米，起始爬升 1500 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3223。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF-01 departure, cruising level 8900 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往莫斯科，按飞行计划航路，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 8900 米，起始爬升 1500 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3223，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, read back correct, contact Wuhan Ground on 121.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，复诵正确，联系武汉地面121.9。

cards.audioText: B: The maintenance staff has deferred an MEL item regarding APU, contact Ground and tell the controller you will be ready to start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: B：维修人员已保留一项关于 APU 的 MEL 项目，联系地面并告诉管制员你将在 5 分钟后准备好在机位启动 1 台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, request start 1 engine at the bay in 5 minutes due to APU problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，因 APU 问题，请求 5 分钟后在机位启动 1 台发动机。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, call me back when ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，准备好推出时再呼叫我。
cards.referenceText: Slot time 50, start 1 engine at the bay approved, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 时隙 50，同意在机位启动 1 台发动机，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, ready for push back.

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, push back onto F, facing south.
cards.referenceText: Push back onto F, facing south, CSN 371.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
C: CSN 371, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A9, hold short of A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，经滑行道 F、A9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，A 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A9, hold short of A, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A9 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，A 外等待，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi an auto brake caution message is displayed on the aircraft warning system, so you stop taxiing, advise Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中飞机警告系统显示自动刹车警戒信息，所以你停止滑行，告知地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, we have an auto brake caution message, we stopped taxiing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，我们有自动刹车警戒信息，我们已停止滑行。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 371, roger, hold at present position, advise your intention when able.
B: Tell the controller you are still able to taxi, but you need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, ask to hold at the convenient position.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 371，收到，在当前位置等待，能够时告知意图。
B：告诉管制员你仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, we are still able to taxi, but we need 5 minutes to deal with the problem, request hold at the convenient position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，我们仍能滑行，但需要 5 分钟处理问题，请求在方便位置等待。

cards.audioText: B: While communicating with mechanic and dispatcher, you discovered that some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, report it to ATC and ask for returning to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：与机务和签派沟通时，你发现机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，向 ATC 报告并请求返回登机口。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 371, some pages of onboard flight manuals were missing, it is against regulation to continue flight, request return to the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 371，机载飞行手册有部分页面缺失，继续飞行违反规定，请求返回登机口。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, taxi to bay 224 via taxiway A8, A, A5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，经滑行道 A8、A、A5 滑行至 224 号机位。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to bay 224 via taxiway A8, A, A5, CSN 371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A8、A、A5 滑行至 224 号机位，CSN 371。

cards.audioText: B: 2 hours later, now you are maintaining 9500 meters, approaching WXI, squawking 3223, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：2 小时后，现在你保持 9500 米，接近 WXI，应答机 3223，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, maintaining 9500 meters, approaching WXI, squawking 3223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，保持 9500 米，接近 WXI，应答机 3223。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, maintain 9500 meters, report VYK.
B: Now you are over VYK, maintaining 9500 meters, report it to Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 VYK 上空，保持 9500 米，向北京管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, over VYK, maintaining 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，VYK 上空，保持 9500 米。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 371, climb to and maintain 10700 meters.
B: Tell Beijing Control you are too heavy, request a step climb to 10700 meters in about 1 hour.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 371，爬升并保持 10700 米。
B：告诉北京管制你太重，请求约 1 小时后阶梯爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 371, request a step climb to 10700 meters in about 1 hour due heavy weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 371，因重量大，请求约 1 小时后阶梯爬升至 10700 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 371, due separation, maintain not greater than Mach 0.80.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 371，因间隔，保持不大于马赫 0.80。
cards.referenceText: Maintain not greater than M.80, CSN 371.
